definitions.label: Preferred audio language
definitions.description: Choose which spoken language Silo should prefer first.
definitions.notes: Migrates user_profiles.language as the roaming fallback. Existing user_device_settings values become real overrides, and the per-series value comes from AudioPreference.audio_language. AudioPreference.audio_track_index and track_signature stay specialized: they identify a concrete track, not a default.

definitions.label: Preferred subtitle language
definitions.description: Choose which subtitle language Silo should prefer first.
definitions.notes: Migrates user_profiles.subtitle_language, LibraryPlaybackPreference.subtitle_language, and SubtitlePreference.subtitle_language. SubtitlePreference.subtitle_track_index, external_subtitle_path, and track_signature stay specialized.

definitions.label: Subtitles
definitions.description: When Silo should turn subtitles on.
definitions.notes: The legacy empty string means unset, not a fourth mode. Migration maps "" to no stored row so it resolves to the next scope.

definitions.label: Show forced subtitles
definitions.description: Show subtitles for foreign-language dialogue even when subtitles are off.
definitions.notes: The existing Has* companion booleans on LibraryPlaybackPreference and SubtitlePreference encode set-vs-unset. Migration writes a row only where Has* is true, so explicit false stays distinct from unset.

definitions.label: Subtitle appearance
definitions.description: How subtitles are drawn during playback.
definitions.notes: Renamed from the unprefixed legacy key "subtitle_appearance". Every other canonical key carries a domain prefix, and preserving accidental key names is an explicit non-goal of the design. Migration copies the account-level legacy fallback to every existing profile and leaves device overrides unchanged.

definitions.label: Preferred quality
definitions.description: Pick the quality Silo should prefer.
definitions.notes: Members are listed ascending so the ceiling constraint has a defined direction; "auto" sorts lowest because it never exceeds a cap. Migrates user_profiles.quality_preference as the profile fallback. The account/profile max_playback_quality columns stay in internal/policy and are NOT settings.

definitions.label: Auto-skip intros
definitions.description: Jump past intros automatically when Silo can detect them.

definitions.label: Auto-skip credits
definitions.description: Move through end credits automatically when a skip is available.

definitions.label: Auto-skip recaps
definitions.description: Skip "previously on" recaps automatically when Silo can detect them.

definitions.label: Auto-play next episode
definitions.description: Continue to the next episode automatically.

definitions.label: Preview next episode
definitions.description: Show a preview of the next episode while credits play.

definitions.label: Next up prompt
definitions.description: How long before the end of an episode the next-up prompt appears.
definitions.notes: Android currently writes player.next_up_prompt_seconds. That alias is migrated to this key and removed from production writes.

definitions.label: Metadata language
definitions.description: Language Silo prefers for titles, descriptions, and artwork.
definitions.notes: Migrates user_profiles.preferred_metadata_language.

definitions.label: HDR
definitions.description: Allow HDR output on this device.

definitions.label: Dolby Vision
definitions.description: Allow Dolby Vision output on this device.

definitions.label: Dolby Vision Profile 7 fallback
definitions.description: Play Profile 7 sources as HDR10 when this device cannot decode them natively.
definitions.notes: Android currently defaults this to true before hydration. The contract default is false, matching the server and Apple.

definitions.label: Seek cache
definitions.description: Keep recently played segments buffered for faster seeking.

definitions.label: Match content frame rate
definitions.description: Switch the display refresh rate to match what is playing.
definitions.notes: Previously an unregistered Android device-setting write, so every write and reset was rejected by the server. Registered here.

definitions.label: Playback speed
definitions.description: Default playback speed on this device.
definitions.notes: Android currently clamps to 4.0. The contract maximum is 3.0, matching the server; the Android clamp and its unit test are corrected to match.

definitions.label: Audio sync offset
definitions.description: Shift audio earlier or later to correct lip sync on this device.

definitions.label: Subtitle sync offset
definitions.description: Shift subtitles earlier or later on this device.

definitions.label: Video sizing
definitions.description: How video fills the screen on this device.

definitions.label: Screen orientation
definitions.description: Whether the player rotates with the device.

definitions.label: Default sleep timer
definitions.description: Preset duration for the sleep timer. 0 leaves it off.
definitions.notes: Previously an unregistered Android device-setting write. The design classes transient sleep timers as private local; the persisted default duration is a real preference, so it is registered while the running timer stays client-local.

definitions.label: Theme
definitions.description: Colour theme for the Silo interface.
definitions.notes: Renamed from the unregistered legacy key "ui_theme", which the extension bag accepted without validation. Moved from account to profile scope: appearance is per household member, and the account row is copied to every profile during migration. Carries a device override because the right theme is partly a function of the screen and the room — a light theme on a phone in daylight, a dark one on a TV at night — which is the same reasoning that gives ui.text_scale one. Note that ui.custom_theme_vars and ui.custom_css stay profile-wide, so a profile's custom styling still applies on top of a device's theme override. Adding a theme is an additive enum widening. The admin-set default theme stays in server_settings and is not a user setting.

definitions.label: Text size
definitions.description: Overall interface text size.
definitions.notes: Renamed from the unregistered legacy key "ui_text_scale". Allows a device override because readable text size is partly a function of the screen you are sitting in front of.

definitions.label: Text weight
definitions.description: Use heavier interface text for readability.
definitions.notes: Renamed from the unregistered legacy key "ui_text_weight".

definitions.label: High contrast
definitions.description: Increase contrast across the interface.
definitions.notes: Renamed from the unregistered legacy key "ui_high_contrast".

definitions.label: Custom theme variables
definitions.description: Per-token overrides applied on top of the selected theme.
definitions.notes: Renamed from the unregistered legacy key "ui_custom_theme_vars", which stored arbitrary unvalidated JSON.

definitions.label: Custom CSS
definitions.description: Raw CSS applied on top of the selected theme.
definitions.notes: Renamed from the unregistered legacy key "ui_custom_css". Sanitization stays in the web client (web/src/lib/cssSanitizer.ts); the contract only bounds length. This value is per-profile and is never applied to another profile's session.

definitions.label: Date format
definitions.description: How dates are written across the interface.
definitions.notes: Moved from account to profile scope; the account row is copied to every profile during migration.

definitions.label: Time format
definitions.description: How clock times are written across the interface.
definitions.notes: Moved from account to profile scope; the account row is copied to every profile during migration.

definitions.label: Remembered library view
definitions.description: Saved browse state for each library.
definitions.notes: Navigation state, not a user-authored preference. Stays tied to one profile on one device and is not shown as a normal setting control.

definitions.label: Remember library view
definitions.description: Return to where you left off when reopening a library.

definitions.label: Search scope
definitions.description: What search covers by default.
definitions.notes: Moved from account to profile scope; the account row is copied to every profile during migration.

definitions.label: Download over Wi-Fi only
definitions.description: Only download while connected to Wi-Fi.
definitions.notes: Contract-known local: the value governs OS-level network constraints on the device holding the files, so it does not roam. Shared semantics across Apple and Android make it contract-owned rather than private.

definitions.label: Keep watched downloads
definitions.description: Do not suggest reclaiming space from downloads you have finished.
definitions.notes: Contract-known local. Governs on-device storage cleanup prompts.

definitions.label: Match device caption settings
definitions.description: Use the operating system's caption style instead of Silo's.
definitions.notes: Contract-known local: reads OS accessibility settings that only exist on the device. When enabled, playback.subtitle_appearance is not applied. Apple's existing copy separating this from profile subtitle behavior is the UX baseline.
